answer: No, you don't need a payoff letter. Bayline Credit Union is in our e-payoff network, so we confirm your payoff directly with them the same day, at your appointment, using your loan account number. Bring the rest of the usual items: a valid photo ID for every owner on the title, the current registration, all keys and remotes, the title if you have it, and form NW-ODO-2. Keep making your regular loan payments until Bayline confirms the loan is paid off.
